tasks.title: plugin-task-ui-7 — Composition-first widgets (every widget accepts a ViewNode)
tasks.description:
EVERY widget must be able to receive a ViewNode (arbitrary child subtree) as its content — the real SwiftUI/Flutter model.

## Scope (original, locked with user 2026-07-08)
1. Make grid-ui widgets composition-first: accept an arbitrary child Component/subtree as content, not only scalar props. Start Label/Button/IconButton/Badge/Tag, then generalize.
2. Complete realize() coverage so every WidgetKind maps to its widget (no empty fallback).
3. Result: any ViewNode renders, any widget can host any widget.
Overlay direction: rename the overlay panel to a base Overlay widget with Modal/Dialog as specializations (composition, not inheritance); BLOCKING STAYS A LAYER PROPERTY; fold in overlay sizing (.panel_size) + scrollable body (ScrollRegion) gaps. FORMALIZE AS ITS OWN PHASE before touching overlay widgets. Update showcase + docs/widgets.md; read all styling from theme; keep vocabulary host-owned.

## BUG A — nested overlay: a Select opened INSIDE a Dialog (found 2026-07-15, F003/P011/T005 showcase)
Two symptoms, ONE root cause: a descendant overlay's panel is not composited/routed above the Dialog's own LATER siblings.
- SHOW-THROUGH (paint/z-order): Dialog paints panel children in order [title, body(Select), action-row]; the Select queues its open list via `cx.with_overlay`, but the action buttons paint AFTER it in the same pass → buttons land on top of the panel (looks translucent; it is z-order — the `surface` token is opaque). See heca-grid-ui/src/widgets/dialog.rs paint child-loop + select.rs open-list paint (~line 622).
- HOVER FALL-THROUGH (input/occlusion): dialog.rs `event()` PointerMoved (~line 336) forwards to the WHOLE panel subtree with no overlay-first routing, so the button under the open panel still highlights. Select's own occlusion (select.rs:696, consume-move-within-panel_rect) works only at the TOP level, because the host routes to `overlay_active` widgets first (focus.rs deliver_event overlay scan ~line 138); the Dialog does not replicate that for a nested open overlay.
FIX (as part of the base-Overlay rework, "blocking stays a layer property"):
1. Route a nested descendant overlay through the app LayerRegistry / surface-compositor as its OWN layer, so an open Select composites above ALL sibling/ancestor chrome — not just local paint order. Nested `cx.with_overlay` inside another overlay is insufficient.
2. Overlay containers (Dialog + the future base Overlay) must deliver pointer/key to an `overlay_active` descendant FIRST (mirror focus.rs overlay scan) and stop propagation to occluded siblings when the descendant's panel_rect contains the pointer.

## BUG B — Dialog off-screen when mounted in-flow / inside a scrolled container (found 2026-07-15)
In the app the Dialog is the layer root: taffy centering (root Pct(1.0)² + Justify/Align Center) centers it on the viewport correctly — NO bug there. In the SHOWCASE it is mounted as `.child(dialog)` inside a vertically-scrolled column, so its box is an in-flow slot and taffy centers the panel inside that slot → off-screen when the trigger is scrolled near the bottom.
FAILED FIX ATTEMPT (2026-07-15, reverted): added `Dialog::on_layout` that shifted the panel to `cx.viewport()`-center via `shift_subtree`. It REGRESSED badly: (a) still off-screen, (b) on re-open the scrim/backdrop painted but the panel did not. WHY: the showcase renders its tree with a vertical SCROLL, so a widget's bounds are in scrolled-tree coordinates, NOT screen coordinates; centering on the absolute `cx.viewport()` throws the panel outside the visible content region. `shift_subtree` is destructive and must be re-derived each layout pass — the showcase's re-open/layout cadence left the panel shifted away while the viewport-anchored scrim still painted (→ backdrop-but-no-panel). Lesson: a Dialog cannot self-center on the absolute viewport when it lives inside a scrolled/offset subtree; centering must be relative to the visible region, or the Dialog must be hosted as a real top-level overlay layer.
CORRECT APPROACH (do here, verify INTERACTIVELY in the GPU showcase — do NOT ship unverified widget changes again): make overlays (Dialog included) host through the app LayerRegistry as their own top-level layer above the scrolled content (same mechanism as the app), rather than living as an in-flow child. Then centering on the viewport is correct because the layer is not inside the scroll offset. This unifies with BUG A's fix (nested/all overlays route through the layer stack).

## BUG C — showcase has no HORIZONTAL scroll (found 2026-07-15)
ScrollRegion is vertical-only by design (grid-ui-chrome-plan.md §2.8 lists horizontal scroll under Future). Content wider than the viewport runs off-screen with no scrollbar. Add horizontal scroll to ScrollRegion (+ a horizontal scrollbar) as part of the overlay/scroll gap-fill, or track separately.

NB: BUG B's widget change was REVERTED (dialog.rs restored to taffy-only centering); the Dialog remains correct in the app. All three belong to this overlay/scroll rework and must be verified interactively.

tasks.title: ScrollRegion two-axis + scrollable surface (overlay/scroll rework Part 1)
tasks.description:
Part 1 of the overlay/scroll rework (design: docs/overlay-design.md §"T009 rework"; sibling: plugin-task-ui-7/T009 owns Part 2 = overlays above the scroll + base Overlay widget). Fixes BUG C (showcase content wider than the viewport runs off-screen with no scrollbar).

CURRENT STATE:
- `ScrollRegion` (heca-grid-ui/src/widgets/scroll_region.rs) is an embeddable VERTICAL-ONLY scroll viewport. It bakes `-scroll_offset` into child bounds (bounds === drawn === clickable), clips via renderer PushClip/PopClip, resets `applied_offset` in `Component::on_layout` (post-order, so the shift never compounds). Public API: `new()`, `scroll_offset() -> Signal<f32>`, `scroll_to(f32)`, `ensure_visible(Rectangle)`, `scroll_to_child(usize)`. Wheel via `Event::Scroll`; auto vertical scrollbar (theme-accent thumb, wide grab lane, control_radius). Module doc explicitly says "v1 is vertical-only; horizontal scrolling is future work."
- The SHOWCASE scrolls its whole page with a MANUAL `offset_tree(dy)` (heca-renderer/examples/showcase.rs ~L1740) — vertical only — NOT a ScrollRegion. That is why wide content has no horizontal scrollbar.
- `Surface`/`StyleExt` (background/border/radius/glow) exist as theme-driven builders on surfaces.

DESIRED STATE (extend ScrollRegion; DO NOT add a parallel widget):
1. Two-axis scrolling. Add `ScrollAxes { Vertical (default), Horizontal, Both }` via builders `.horizontal()`/`.both()` (default Vertical = back-compat; existing callers unchanged). Per-axis offset — decision Q2 lean: keep the existing `scroll_offset()` Signal<f32> as the vertical accessor and ADD a horizontal `scroll_offset_x()` Signal<f32> (two signals, smaller diff) rather than switching to a Point. Lay children at natural size on BOTH axes (no shrink) so content overflows horizontally; bake `-offset` on both axes in the same place the vertical shift is applied; clip to the region rect (already done).
2. Horizontal scrollbar on the bottom edge mirroring the vertical thumb (theme-accent grip, wide invisible grab lane, control_radius); auto-shown only when the horizontal axis overflows. Q1 lean: overlay/auto-hide over content (match the vertical thumb), no reserved gutter.
3. Wheel/trackpad: plain `Event::Scroll` delta → vertical; Shift+wheel → horizontal; a 2-D delta drives both. Clamp each axis to [0, max_offset]. Confirm what `Event::Scroll` carries (dx/dy? modifiers?) in component.rs before wiring.
4. Optional "scrollable surface" styling: give ScrollRegion optional `StyleExt` (background/border/radius/glow), theme-driven — a plain `ScrollRegion::new()` stays frameless, `.background(..).border(..)` makes it a scrollable panel. No hardcoded styling.
5. Showcase adopts it: replace the manual `offset_tree` page-scroll with a root `ScrollRegion::new().both()` wrapping the content (dogfood; fixes BUG C). NB: overlays (Dialog/Select) must be hosted ABOVE this scroll — that is Part 2 (T009); until then the in-flow Dialog stays off-screen when scrolled (BUG B) — do not attempt to fix BUG B here.

EDGE CASES: content smaller than viewport on an axis → no scrollbar, offset pinned 0; on_layout must reset BOTH axes' applied offsets; `ensure_visible`/`scroll_to_child` stay vertical for now (or extend if cheap); back-compat — `scroll_offset()` semantics unchanged for vertical-only callers.

VERIFY INTERACTIVELY (mandatory — see the no-unverified-rendering lesson): unit-test the pure clamp/offset math; then the USER runs `cargo run -p heca-renderer --example showcase` to confirm horizontal + vertical scroll, the bottom scrollbar, Shift+wheel, and that a styled scrollable surface renders. Do NOT mark done on green unit tests alone.

DOCS (both audiences, per the rule): docs/widgets.md ScrollRegion entry (new builders + horizontal scrollbar + StyleExt, native + declarative examples) + rustdoc; showcase demo section.
